source: Alex Hormozi — The Blueprint for Making Money From Scratch

skills_first.name: Skills First Mentality
skills_first.when: When advising someone on how to start a business with no money
elements: Buy skills not things with every dollar you have
Skills are the only assets that follow you everywhere
Rich people only think about: what can I learn and what can this skill get me
Once you have enough skills buy other people's skills and time
skills_first.note: This is the foundational framework. Everything else comes after skills.

use_what_you_have.name: Use What You Have
use_what_you_have.when: When someone feels stuck or blocked from starting
use_what_you_have.essence: Use what you have not what you wish you had to get where you want to go
use_what_you_have.implication: Stop waiting for perfect resources. The path reveals itself through action not planning.
use_what_you_have.opposite: Waiting for the right idea, money, or timing before starting

volume_negates_luck.name: Volume Negates Luck
volume_negates_luck.when: When someone feels outpaced by competitors or not getting traction
volume_negates_luck.ratio: The people ahead are not doing 2x or 3x more. They are doing 100x more.
volume_negates_luck.application: If they make 500 ads a month and you make 5 you cannot win on quality alone. Increase volume to the point it feels uncomfortable.
volume_negates_luck.note: This is not about working harder. It is about realizing the gap is bigger than you think.

voluntary_exchange.name: Voluntary Exchange Principle
voluntary_exchange.when: When someone is unsure how money is actually made in business
voluntary_exchange.essence: Money is made through voluntary exchange. You give something to someone first and they give you money back. Both parties say thank you because both are better off.
voluntary_exchange.implication: If you are not giving value first you are not building a business.

key_tactics: The first thing you sell is not the last thing you will sell. Start with any sale to learn how to sell.
You do not need to feel a certain way to win. Start from anger, sadness, shame, or fear. Winning when struggling counts just as much.
Everything comes down to buying time. Pay for others' skills so you do not have to learn everything yourself.
Generalize from being good at skills to being good at people who have skills.
Money follows exchange not intention. No exchange = no business.
